sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a dense multimodal model from the Qwen3.5 family — same gated delta networks hybrid attention, vision encoder, 262K context, and MTP support as its larger siblings, but sized to fit comfortably on a single 24 GB GPU.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B - Visual LLM | OVHcloud
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 9B is a highly efficient, reasoning focused model delivering state of the art performance in language, vision, and multimodal tasks, with strong capabilities in code, reasoning, and real-world adaptability.

sources.snippet: Qwen's 9B multimodal model with hybrid architecture, 262K native context, vision-language reasoning, native tool calling, and 201-language support for agentic workflows

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: The flagship of Alibaba's small dense Qwen3.5 models. Independent analysis (Artificial Analysis) rated it the most intelligent model under 10B parameters at launch — roughly double the score of the next-closest sub-10B models — and the most intelligent multimodal model under 15B, leading peers on MMMU-Pro (~69%). sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B: Specs, Benchmarks & Model Details | DataLearnerAI
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is a multimodal model from Alibaba, released on 2026-03-02. It accepts text, image, and video input and returns text output. The cataloged parameter count is 9B. The recorded context window is 262K. Cataloged capabilities include Reasoning model and Multilingual.
